Exact alarms allowed in Doze are the costly kind: they go off on time even in deep sleep, and each one wakes the phone on its own. Ordinary alarms and jobs wait for Doze\'s short maintenance windows and share them.
What apps have planned right now; they can change it any time. Read only while you look. Tap an app for details.
In App info under Battery you can restrict the app\'s background use. Under Alarms & reminders you can take away its exact alarms. Activity+ never changes this itself.
%1$s wakes the phone every %2$s, even in Doze

It sets an exact alarm that may go off in Doze, about every %1$s. Each one pulls the phone out of deep sleep, all night long. In App info under Battery you can restrict it; Planned for tonight on the Battery screen also opens its Alarms & reminders page.
